maddeler.e:
أنحلب (form VII)
# أَنْحَلِبُ (ʔanḥalibu) /ʔan.ħa.li.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْحَلَبَ (inḥalaba)
# أَنْحَلِبَ (ʔanḥaliba) /ʔan.ħa.li.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَلَبَ (inḥalaba)
# أَنْحَلِبْ (ʔanḥalib) /ʔan.ħa.lib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْحَلَبَ (inḥalaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
